package parsers

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/parsers"
)

func TestParseSortOptions(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name      string
		query     url.Values
		wantNil   bool
		checkFunc func(*testing.T, *filters.SortOptions)
	}{
		{
			name:    "empty query",
			query:   url.Values{},
			wantNil: true,
		},
		{
			name: "valid sort by created_at asc",
			query: url.Values{
				"sort":  []string{"created_at"},
				"order": []string{"asc"},
			},
			wantNil: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, s *filters.SortOptions) {
				if s.Field != filters.SortFieldCreatedAt {
					t.Errorf("field should be SortFieldCreatedAt, got %v", s.Field)
				}
				if s.Order != filters.SortOrderASC {
					t.Errorf("order should be ASC, got %v", s.Order)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "valid sort by updated_at desc",
			query: url.Values{
				"sort":  []string{"updated_at"},
				"order": []string{"desc"},
			},
			wantNil: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, s *filters.SortOptions) {
				if s.Field != filters.SortFieldUpdatedAt {
					t.Errorf("field should be SortFieldUpdatedAt, got %v", s.Field)
				}
				if s.Order != filters.SortOrderDESC {
					t.Errorf("order should be DESC, got %v", s.Order)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "valid sort by title",
			query: url.Values{
				"sort":  []string{"title"},
				"order": []string{"asc"},
			},
			wantNil: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, s *filters.SortOptions) {
				if s.Field != filters.SortFieldTitle {
					t.Errorf("field should be SortFieldTitle, got %v", s.Field)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "case insensitive field",
			query: url.Values{
				"sort":  []string{"CREATED_AT"},
				"order": []string{"ASC"},
			},
			wantNil: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, s *filters.SortOptions) {
				if s.Field != filters.SortFieldCreatedAt {
					t.Errorf("field should be SortFieldCreatedAt (case insensitive), got %v", s.Field)
				}
				if s.Order != filters.SortOrderASC {
					t.Errorf("order should be ASC (case insensitive), got %v", s.Order)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "invalid sort field",
			query: url.Values{
				"sort":  []string{"invalid_field"},
				"order": []string{"asc"},
			},
			wantNil: true,
		},
		{
			name: "sort without order defaults to asc",
			query: url.Values{
				"sort": []string{"created_at"},
			},
			wantNil: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, s *filters.SortOptions) {
				if s.Order != filters.SortOrderASC {
					t.Errorf("order should default to ASC, got %v", s.Order)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "order without sort is ignored",
			query: url.Values{
				"order": []string{"desc"},
			},
			wantNil: true,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			req := &http.Request{
				URL: &url.URL{
					RawQuery: tt.query.Encode(),
				},
			}

			result := parsers.ParseSortOptions(req)

			if tt.wantNil {
				if result != nil {
					t.Errorf("expected nil, got %v", result)
				}
				return
			}

			if result == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected non-nil result")
			}

			if tt.checkFunc != nil {
				tt.checkFunc(t, result)
			}
		})
	}
}
